_comment: Тексты сайта kvp-projects.com по продуктам (карточки, страницы, «Как удалить»). Опознавательные поля — id ленты, схема ссылок, минимальная система, архитектура, пути к журналам и значкам — берутся из реестра core/spec/products.json (build.py, merge_registry). Здесь — только то, что пишется для людей. The catalog of kvp-projects.com. A product = one entry; a new platform = one more item in its platforms (kind: mac, chrome, windows, linux, ios, android). build.py makes the pages from this file and the products' changelogs. A Mac platform's «scheme» is the app's URL scheme: the license activation page opens <scheme>://activate?key=…. «license_path» — where the License section is in the app's settings (ru/en), shown on the activation page. «ui_langs» — the app's interface languages; an English page says «Russian only» when en is missing. «benefit» — what the app gives you, one line under the name on cards and the product page; «gains» — three {title, text} for «Что даёт» on a Mac app's page (no gains — no section).

benefit.ru: Говоришь — и текст сразу там, где стоит курсор
benefit.en: Speak, and the text appears right where your cursor is

ru.title: Говорить быстрее, чем печатать
ru.text: Письма, заметки, сообщения — голосом, в любой программе, без переключения окон.

en.text: Emails, notes, messages — by voice, in any app, without switching windows.

en.title: Clean text right away

en.title: Your voice stays on your Mac

Словарь с формами слов, история диктовок по дням
Музыка на время записи приглушается или встаёт на паузу

Modes, each with its own model, language and AI text processing
A live pill with the text as you speak, pause and switch modes on the fly
A dictionary with word forms, dictation history by day
Music is lowered or paused while you record

ru.title: Действия — там, где ты пишешь

en.title: Actions where you type
en.text: One key opens a panel at your cursor: translate, fix or rewrite the selection without switching windows.

en.title: Buttons for what you selected
en.text: A link, an email, a phone number, an address, an expression or an amount in a currency — Textum offers the right action.

en.title: Less retyping
en.text: Text typed in the wrong keyboard layout gets fixed, and snippets expand a short keyword into ready text in any app.

summary.en: One key opens an action panel at your cursor: AI, smart buttons for the kind of text, snippets, emoji, and fixing text typed in the wrong keyboard layout.

Smart buttons for links, email, phone numbers, addresses, expressions and currencies
Snippets: a keyword expands into text in any app
Layout switcher: fixes text typed in the wrong keyboard layout
Emoji gallery with search
